tools_helpful.evidence: Bootstrap copied 4 source files, rewrote Windows.UI.Xaml->Microsoft.UI.Xaml in 3/9 files, seeded MIGRATION-MAPPING.md + .fidelity-snapshot.json (toolResult 5).
Agent fetched the GetForCurrentView and Windowing pattern text before migrating Scenario1/2 (toolResults 27-28).
Reported PASS after migration; final build succeeded with only 4 nullable warnings (sub-agent summary).

failed_apis.why_tried: Scenario 1 shows 'Logical DPI for this scale'.
failed_apis.root_cause: DisplayInformation is view-bound and unavailable in WinUI 3 desktop; skill maps it to RasterizationScale but gives no LogicalDpi formula.

failed_apis.why_tried: Scenario 1 must refresh the scale/DPI readout when display scale changes.
failed_apis.root_cause: No WinUI 3 event mapping in the skill for the DPI-change notification (only orientation's OrientationChanged->AppWindow.Changed is mapped).

special_apis.special_handling: Null/invalid until the element is loaded. Agent read it from Loaded and guarded OnNavigatedTo with 'if (XamlRoot != null)'; navigation was deferred to Window.Activated so App.MainWindow/XamlRoot exist first.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: No direct skill mapping for LogicalDpi, the DpiChanged event, or when RasterizationScale is readable.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: DisplayInformation section explicitly says the GetForCurrentView row 'only covers the DPI use case' but then expands orientation only, leaving the DPI path (LogicalDpi formula, DpiChanged event, read-after-Loaded timing) undocumented.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Capable driver model derived logicalDpi=96*scale, XamlRoot.Changed, and Loaded-timing on its own.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Add a DPI mini-mapping (LogicalDpi=96*RasterizationScale, DpiChanged->XamlRoot.Changed) plus the read-after-Loaded timing rule to the DisplayInformation section of MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md.

env_issues.issue: winapp 'ui screenshot' returns blank frames for the WinUI 3 swap-chain surface in the headless session; UWP scenario-2 golden not capturable (opaque CoreWindow UIA + no mouse injection).
env_issues.workaround: Eval verified fidelity via UIA tree. These are measurement-instrument limits, not migration defects.
